runtime.licenseStatement: Upstream README states runtime code is MIT
runtime.changes: Windows/Android embedding, C host ABI, HTTP transports, PCM transfer and file/image fixes; no SDK CoreLibs copied

SDL2.changes: CRANK_EMBEDDED_SDL guards in pthread, audio and RWops sources bypass SDLActivity JNI for the UE host; notices retained

unicorn.changes: ARM-only static build; local compatibility header renames the CRC32 helper symbol to avoid the zlib export. Upstream source is unchanged. Notices retained in runtime/deps/unicorn.

nativeArchitectureReference.usage: Reference for pdex.bin layout, Cortex-M7 SDK emulation and API table layout; existing Lua backend is retained and bridged by the local pd_native implementation. No upstream contribution was made.

deviceViewer.assets: Original asheville mesh, texture maps, LogLuv environment and shadow
deviceViewer.changes: Three-to-UE basis conversion and original panorama IBL algorithm adapted to a UE material
deviceViewer.licenseStatement: Source attribution; no open-source license is asserted for the website assets
